approval_time_estimate: No review step documented; paid usage credits required
summary: X's developer platform is now self-serve: sign in at console.x.com with your X account, accept the Developer Agreement, create an app and copy its credentials. API usage is billed pay-per-usage from credits you buy in advance, with no monthly fee. X is not in Composio's managed OAuth list, so you register your own app and supply the client ID and secret.
key_facts: Sign up at console.x.com with an X account and accept the Developer Agreement
API credentials are shown once when the app is created — regenerating them invalidates the old ones
Billing is pay-per-usage: buy credits up front, usage draws them down at per-endpoint rates; the same resource requested twice in 24 hours is charged once
Not covered by Composio managed OAuth — you must bring your own OAuth app (client ID + secret)
Older Free / Basic ($100) / Pro ($5,000) tier descriptions may be out of date — check the pricing page before relying on them
Team roles (Administrator / Developer) are limited to Enterprise accounts

steps.title: Sign up on the X Developer Console
steps.description: Go to console.x.com, sign in with your X account and accept the Developer Agreement.
warnings: Be specific and honest — vague answers cause delays or rejection
Mentioning automation should be tied to clear user-serving purposes

steps.title: Add credits
steps.description: API usage is billed pay-per-usage. Buy credits up front; new accounts may be offered free credits (see the free-credits page linked from the docs).

steps.title: Create an App
steps.description: Click 'New App', enter a name and description, then save the API Key, API Secret and tokens immediately — they are shown only once. In the app settings configure authentication, permissions and the callback URL (for Composio: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback).

steps.title: Configure OAuth 2.0
steps.description: In your App settings, go to 'User authentication settings'. Enable OAuth 2.0. Set Type of App (Web App/Native App). Add callback URLs and website URL. Select required scopes (tweet.read, tweet.write, users.read, offline.access for refresh tokens).
warnings: offline.access scope is required if you want refresh tokens for long-lived access

steps.title: Get API Keys and Configure Composio
steps.description: From App settings → Keys and tokens: get Client ID and Client Secret (for OAuth 2.0). Configure in Composio custom auth config with toolkit='twitter'.

requirements.account_type: Twitter/X account + Developer Portal approval + paid plan for real usage

blockers.title: Paid credits required
blockers.description: API usage draws down prepaid credits. Without credits, requests fail.
blockers.workaround: Add credits in the console and monitor usage; check the free-credits page for new accounts.

blockers.title: Pricing and process change often
blockers.description: Earlier tiers (Free / Basic / Pro) and a manual approval step are widely reported but are not described in the current developer-console docs.
blockers.workaround: Check the current pricing page and your console before budgeting.
